name: Frozen Horror
description: The Frozen Horror quest pack and its free prelude, Into the Northlands. The quests are added as they are encoded.

campaignSettings.name: Raiment of the Frozen Champion
campaignSettings.text: Adds two warning lines to the monster cards: a Gremlin cannot steal from a hero wearing the Cold Iron Plate Mail, and a Yeti cannot hug a hero carrying the Spiked Shield. Hiding the four artifacts in the quests is not part of the app yet: place them yourself.
